text: The data breach described has a severe impact due to the highly sensitive nature of the compromised information. The unauthorized access involved medical records containing patient names, health insurance details, medical histories, and treatment information. This combination of personally identifiable information (PII) and protected health information (PHI) creates a significant risk for both identity theft and insurance fraud. With 200,000 individuals affected, the breach not only jeopardizes the privacy and financial security of a large population but also exposes the healthcare provider to substantial legal, regulatory, and reputational consequences.
